drivers.notes: Same V2 REST API across the entire CX / C / CB family. Feature differences (number of paired buttons, dual video outputs on CX-50 Gen2, UVC pass-through on CX-30 Gen2 / CX-50 Gen2) are reported by the Base Unit at runtime in the `supportedOutputs`, `supportedModes`, `supportedPowerModes`, etc. arrays — the driver doesn't need to know the model. Older CSE / CSC ClickShare units use a different (legacy) API and are NOT covered.
